items.q: And I bought 2 cars, and Bart bought the Desoto back and he was working out the office

ctx.x: And I bought 2 cars, and Bart bought the Desoto back and he was working out the office, and I took a loss on the Mercury. It was on a promissory note with Ben, but he had to get rid of them to get his money back. He had to shove it off on somebody. I took a loss on the Mercury. I had a '49 Mercury and a '48 Desoto convertible. Suburban.
Who were the guys you were gonna take out?
